name: scriptfiles and dispatch references
command: ls -l /usr/syscfg/ScriptFiles; grep -rnE 'ScriptFiles|/etc/preinit|/lib/preinit|mount_root|rc.local|autorun' /etc/rc.d /usr/syscfg /etc/inittab 2>/dev/null | head -70; for f in /usr/sbin/tdsmgr /usr/sbin/sysmgr /usr/sbin/srvcmgr; do echo $f; strings $f | grep -E '^(/data/[^ ]*|.*ScriptFiles.*|.*authorized_keys.*|.*sys.init.sh.*)$' | head -30; done

name: public host identity final
command: dropbearkey -y -f /var/dropbear/rsa_host_key 2>/dev/null | grep '^ssh-rsa '; cat /proc/uptime; test ! -e /tmp/dlink-phase6a && echo clean; id -u
